Please accept before joining the chat:

• Insults, harassment, hate speech and threats are not allowed.
• Sexual content, spam and scams are not allowed.
• Don't share personal information (phone number, address, etc.).

You can report and block users who break the rules by long-pressing their messages or from the menu in the top right. Reports are reviewed; accounts that violate the rules are removed from the app.
